name: InterContinental Malta
insider_take: This stunning Mediterranean jewel sits on the former site of a 17th-century fort, seamlessly blending Malta's rich history with ultra-modern luxury along St. Julian's coveted coastline.
whats_special: The hotel features Malta's largest outdoor infinity pool and is built around the restored Fort San Gorg watchtower. Its prime Balluta Bay location offers direct sea access and panoramic views of the Mediterranean, while the property's contemporary design incorporates locally quarried Maltese limestone throughout.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over Balluta Bay, and visit the rooftop bar at sunset when the historic Valletta skyline glows golden across the harbor.
dont_miss: The award-winning Iniala Spa with its unique underwater relaxation pods, and a short stroll to Spinola Bay's famous fishing boats and waterfront restaurants. The hotel is also perfectly positioned for day trips to UNESCO World Heritage Valletta, just 15 minutes away.
pros: Prime St. Julians location with Mediterranean Sea views
Luxury InterContinental brand amenities and service standards
Access to Malta's vibrant nightlife and dining scene
Modern facilities with spa and wellness options
cons: Located in busy tourist area of St. Julians
